hero.title: Front-end systems for products that can’t afford to feel slow.
hero.intro-1: I’m Salar, a senior front-end developer based in Sari, Iran. Over the past five years I’ve shipped 40+ projects, moving from marketing sites to leading front-end work on nationwide platforms, executive BI dashboards, and e-commerce products.
hero.intro-2: My work sits where design, data, and performance meet: turning dense requirements into interfaces that feel simple, stay responsive under real data, and hold up in production. I care about design systems, accessibility, and the last 10% that makes a product feel finished.
hero.facts-note: Includes private client work and projects under NDA.

hero.description: Hi, I’m Salar — a Senior Front-End Developer. I used to write code; now I mostly tell Claude what to write and review its work — patiently waiting for the day it stops needing me to do even that.

about.title: About me
about.description: A front-end lead with 40+ shipped projects across dashboards, platforms, and customer-facing products.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Developer
highlights: Building front-end interfaces for Cyberno's cybersecurity products and services.
Collaborating with product and engineering teams to deliver responsive, accessible user experiences.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Developer
highlights: Designed and delivered high-performance, multi-source BI dashboards for global and local clients using Next.js, Recharts, and Highcharts, supporting complex real-time data flows across 5+ integrated sources.
Architected frontend solutions with SSR, TanStack Query caching, and lazy loading strategies, targeting sub-2s load times and measurable Core Web Vitals improvements across all client deliverables.
Implemented i18next-based internationalization with full RTL support, enabling product delivery to both Persian and English-speaking markets from a single codebase.

positions.title: Front-End Tech Lead | Oct 2021 – Jan 2026
highlights: Defined and enforced organization-wide frontend standards — including ESLint configs, Prettier, Husky Git hooks, branching workflows, and component patterns — adopted across all projects and CI/CD pipelines.

Architected a national-scale executive BI dashboard integrating multiple REST APIs — featuring KPI cards, geo maps, filterable tables, and Recharts visualizations; achieved <2s load time via Next.js SSR and TanStack Query caching.
Established a component library with 10+ reusable modules built with Mantine and React, reducing estimated development time for new dashboards by ~30%.
Migrated UI styling approach from Bootstrap to Tailwind CSS across new projects, standardizing design tokens and reducing custom CSS overhead.

Onboarded and mentored 10+ junior developers and interns through a structured 3-month training program covering HTML, CSS, SCSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, and jQuery, with 5+ promoted to mid-level roles.

positions.title: UI Designer & Front-End Developer | Jun 2021 – Oct 2021
highlights: Built 20+ responsive interfaces from design mockups using Bootstrap and JavaScript for CMS platforms, internal dashboards, and specialized client websites.

positions.title: Front-End Developer
highlights: Independently led frontend development for end-to-end implementation and successful delivery of diverse client web solutions.
Designed and launched the agency's flagship website, prioritizing SEO best practices and performance optimization.
Developed and shipped multiple campaign microsites for Nazari Cake, maintaining cohesive brand identity and seamless mobile experiences.
